description: This file defines an abstract class ListFinder used for finding and retrieving lists of entity values within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages configuration from XML elements, constructs entity conditions, handles cache and transaction options, and delegates output handling to specific implementations. The class provides core logic for executing entity lookups with various parameters and constraints.

classes.name: ListFinder
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for entity listing and search within OFBiz, supporting configuration via XML and managing execution options such as cache, date filtering, and transaction handling.

methods.name: runFind
methods.description: Performs the entity find operation based on configured parameters, handling cache, transaction scope, and output delegation.

methods.name: getOrderByFieldList
methods.description: Returns the list of order-by fields to be used in the entity lookup, based on the current context.

methods.name: getWhereEntityCondition
methods.description: Provides an extensible point to define the 'where' condition for the entity lookup; defaults to null.

methods.name: getHavingEntityCondition
methods.description: Provides an extensible point to define the 'having' condition; defaults to null.
